# Getting help

- **Using whatcategory in your app:** read the [README](../README.md) first. If you're still stuck,
  ask in [Discussions, under Q&A](https://github.com/Things-Varun-Codes/whatcategory/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **A title got the wrong category:** [report a wrong suggestion](https://github.com/Things-Varun-Codes/whatcategory/issues/new?template=wrong_suggestion.yml).
- **Something is broken:** [open a bug report](https://github.com/Things-Varun-Codes/whatcategory/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **An idea:** start a thread in [Discussions, under Ideas](https://github.com/Things-Varun-Codes/whatcategory/discussions/categories/ideas).
- **A security problem:** not in public, please. [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) says how.

This is a spare-time project with one maintainer, so answers can take a few days.
